# Events

At EAFIT University's Continuing Education program, we offer a variety of events designed to enrich the academic and cultural experience of the community at large. Our programming includes events with admission fee and events without admission fee adapting to diverse needs and preferences.

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/en)
- [Other Programs](https://www.eafit.edu.co/en/otros-programas)
- Events

![Image In Guarandinga to the moon](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/41d355b7-a607-4e69-a207-43f5c1659d64/web/guarandinga.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=397&h=253&itok=BjmKzNzi)

In Guarandinga to the moon

A concert to play and enjoy as a family, featuring Cubans Rita del Prado and Dúo Karma, with varied rhythms and songs that bring us closer to the musical, environmental and cultural richness of Cuba.

[Go to the event](https://ticketexpress.com.co/event/en-guarandinga-hasta-la-luna/)

![Image Latin American Practice and Process Gathering (LAPPG)](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/0870a4bd-e9d1-4561-9e5b-9937e82e5af4/web/latin.america.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=397&h=253&itok=Nf-CQFU0)

Latin American Practice and Process Gathering (LAPPG)

A space is offered for the consolidation of a sustainable Latin American research community for the study of practices and processes, transferring cutting-edge knowledge from the global academic conversation to create networks and high-impact research capabilities.

[Go to the event](https://ticketexpress.com.co/event/latin-american-practice-process-gathering-lappg/)

![COIN Image 2024](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/84a0c950-c87a-4384-9f3a-9b639e22006b/web/coin-2024.png?crop=yes&k=c&w=397&h=253&itok=BsGz-GQI)

COIN 2024

Get ready for the 9th edition of the event that will transform your vision of investment opportunities! The Investment and Business Club presents COIN 2024: Opportunities Amidst Uncertainty. Join us for an experience of discovery and learning on October 24th and 25th at EAFIT University.

[Go to the event](https://ticketexpress.com.co/event/coin-2024/)

![Image XVIII Administrative Law Conference](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/2c1fff31-77c9-430d-b671-1a00906fd568/web/jornada-de-derecho.png?crop=yes&k=c&w=397&h=253&itok=qwfWox6Q)

XVIII Conference on Administrative Law

Assessment and reflections on administrative law, master class and fiscal responsibility of state contractors

[Go to the event](https://ticketexpress.com.co/event/xviii-jornadas-de-derecho-administrativo/)

##### **Value proposition**

**Paid events** : These events are designed to offer high-quality experiences that require an investment to participate. They may include specialized conferences, advanced workshops, and seminars with international experts. Each paid event is designed to provide significant value, promoting the learning and professional development of our attendees.

**Free events** : Our offerings also include free activities such as informational talks, interactive workshops, and cultural events. Our goal is to encourage participation and knowledge sharing in an inclusive environment, enriching university life at no cost.

We invite you to explore our programming and participate in events that align with your interests and expectations.
